references.text: The tithe of everything from the land belongs to the Lord and is holy to him. This is the basis for the tithe given to the Levites.
The Lord gives all the tithes in Israel to the Levites as their inheritance, in return for the service they perform at the tent of meeting.
The Levites shall give a tenth of the tithes they receive as an offering to the Lord.
The tribe of Levi has no inheritance among its brothers; the Lord himself is their inheritance.
The Israelites are to rejoice together with the Levites, who have no inheritance among them.
The Israelites must not forget the Levite living in their towns, for he has no inheritance among them. The tithe shall be given every third year.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the Lord's offerings are their inheritance, as the Lord had said.
The Levites were given no portion in the land, but cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock.
The Levites shall have the Lord as their inheritance; they shall have no other inheritance in Israel.
The sons of Levi who become priests are entitled by law to take tithes from the people.
